subject: Throughput degradation on token pipeline — credit request and next steps

Cc: accounting@skylarkai.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Token pipeline degraded throughput (noticed 08/20) — any SLA remedies?

Hi Lauren,

We saw a sustained throughput degradation in our tokenization pipeline between 02:00–03:40 UTC today (roughly 1 hour 40 minutes). Our ingestion queues backed up and summarized traffic shows a ~40% drop in tokens/sec for our steady-state workloads. This impacted a subset of production traffic (approx 12% of requests routed to the hosted endpoint).

Could you confirm whether this incident qualifies for an SLA offset/credit and, if so, what the expected credit calculation would be? I'm attaching our logs slice and a short CSV of request counts.

Attachments: skylark_request_logs_20270820.txt (text), skylark_ingest_counts_20270820.csv (csv)

Appreciate quick guidance — our finance team asked for an approximation today so they can prepare the month-end reconciliation.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Director of Platform Operations
Skylark AI

Hi Priya — thanks for the data and the flags. We're sorry for the disruption. I opened INC-2027-0890 and looped in SRE and Sales so we can triage eligibility and get a credit estimate. Two quick notes:

- We need to confirm the affected uptime window in our telemetry (we'll cross-check the exact topology shard IDs).
- For eligibility we use the standard SLO window and prorated token-based calculation in the customer SLA; if the reduction impacted only a subset of requests we'll prorate by affected traffic.

Marissa, can you take the logs Priya attached and run the shard-level availability runbook? Ben — I cc'd you because finance reconciliation may want to coordinate issuance timing.

I'll update Priya within a few hours with a preliminary credit estimate and the expected issuance path (invoice adjustment vs. account credit).

On Fri, Aug 20, 2027 at 10:02 AM lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marissa, can you take the logs Priya attached and run the shard-level availability runbook?

I pulled the logs and matched request routing. Quick summary:

- Incident window (per our control plane telemetry): 2027-08-20T09:58:00Z–2027-08-20T11:36:00Z (1h38m) affecting 3 of 18 shard instances in us-west; overall customer traffic impacted: 12.3% of token throughput during that window.
- Root cause: transient backpressure caused by an autoscaling race when a kernel fallback path triggered on 2 GPU hosts; patch rolling to runtime will prevent recurrence (postmortem in progress).

Preliminary credit calc (per SLA):
- Monthly committed tokens (billing baseline): 2,400,000 tokens/day average for August
- Window fraction of day: 1.633 hours / 24 = 0.0681
- Affected traffic fraction: 12.3%
- Pro-rated credit = monthly daily charge * window fraction * affected fraction

I created a simple workbook and attached the sheet: cred_calc_SKYLARK_20270821.xlsx (tab: preliminary). Using the committed rate from billing, the estimated credit maps to an invoice offset of $3,420. This is a preliminary number — finance review required for final issuance.

Ben — for approvals, confirm if we can route this as an invoice adjustment against August usage or if you prefer an account credit (Skylark accounting preference?). If invoice offset, we will emit a credit memo referencing DL-4820-SKYL and attach it to next invoice; if account credit, we can post immediately to their account ledger.

I'll continue the postmortem and add the mitigation timeline.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Token pipeline degraded throughput (noticed 08/20) — credit approved and issuance timeline

Hi Priya / Skylark team — thanks for your patience while we completed the eligibility check and preliminary calculations.

Summary and resolution:
- Incident window confirmed: 2027-08-20T09:58:00Z–2027-08-20T11:36:00Z (1h38m).
- Affected fraction of token throughput: 12.3%.
- Preliminary invoice-offset credit approved: $3,420 (reference: DL-4820-SKYL).

Next steps:
1) Finance will issue a formal credit memo (credit_note_SKYLARK_20270821.pdf) that will be applied to the August invoice. Expect delivery to Skylark accounting within 3 business days.
2) Postmortem: SRE will publish a short postmortem summary and mitigation steps (INC-2027-0890). I will follow up with that link when available.
3) Preventive: We pushed a runtime patch to remove the kernel fallback race and have scheduled an extra canary pass over the weekend; SRE will monitor shard stability.

If you prefer an immediate account ledger credit instead of an invoice offset, let me know and we can coordinate.

Attachments: credit_note_SKYLARK_20270821.pdf (PDF - official credit memo)

Thanks again — we'll keep you posted on the postmortem.

Best,
